core_obligations: Explain the obstruction: the proof points out that an infinite direct sum of locally free or quasi-coherent modules need not have the same property, because the neighbourhoods supplied by the various summands may have an intersection which is no longer a neighbourhood of the point (proof lines 3692-3698)

Find a uniform neighbourhood: it then recalls from the proof of the earlier permanence statement that once a suitable open neighbourhood for the given module has been chosen, the same neighbourhood works for each of the tensor, exterior and symmetric powers (proof lines 3698-3703)
Conclude: on that neighbourhood each power has the required property, hence so do the direct sums defining the three algebras, which is the statement (proof lines 3704-3705)
proof_roadmap: 指出困难：无穷直和一般并不保持局部自由/拟凝聚，因为各直和项所需的邻域之交集可能不再是邻域。
但由 lemma-tensor-algebra-permanence 的证明，一旦为 F 选好合适的邻域，该邻域对每个 T^n(F)、Λ^n(F)、Sym^n(F) 都适用；于是三者在同一邻域上各具相应性质，其直和亦然。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the whole tensor, exterior and symmetric algebras of a quasi-coherent module are quasi-coherent, and likewise for local freeness (author lemma at source lines 3677-3689, label lemma-whole-tensor-algebra-permanence). The proof (source lines 3691-3705) first explains why this is not formal from the permanence of finite direct sums, namely that the neighbourhoods supplied by the summands need not have a common neighbourhood of the point, and then invokes the fact, established in the proof of the earlier permanence statement, that a single suitably chosen neighbourhood works simultaneously for all powers (proof lines 3692-3703). The identification of the obstruction and its remedy is the content. H2.
